caption:
Return every greeting with a better one today

Allah tells us that when we are greeted, we should respond with a better greeting or at least return the same. Make your reply to every greeting a little warmer today.

Surah An-Nisaa 4:86

Who is the first person you will greet warmly today?

#salam #greetings #muslimmanners #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais
